source.title: Updates on WCA Competition Requirements Policy & WCA Dues Policy (September 2021)
source.content:
The WCA Board has recently approved the updates to the following policies:

* [WCA Competition Requirements Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) - Includes an introduction and increased scope of series competitions and a variety of adjustments to previously created sections. The full list of changes can be found [here](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/258).
* [WCA Dues Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Dues%20System.pdf) - These changes will take effect starting January 1, 2022 and can be viewed [here](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/253/files#diff-9c4c9b91069f0ac66a52c3409dd14c72581d06f17bbf0f6ce7059541b7409a70).

translation.title: WCA 比赛要求政策和会费政策更新（2021 年 9 月）
translation.content:
WCA 董事会近日批准了以下政策的更新：

* [WCA 比赛要求政策](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)：新增对系列赛的介绍，扩大其适用范围，并对原有章节作出多项调整。完整改动列表见[此处](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/258)。
* [WCA 会费政策](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Dues%20System.pdf)：改动将于 2022 年 1 月 1 日生效，具体内容见[此处](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/253/files#diff-9c4c9b91069f0ac66a52c3409dd14c72581d06f17bbf0f6ce7059541b7409a70)。
